## Briefly write about the project that you have submitted from the perspective of the user.
The project I submitted is a Form Builder Application designed to allow users to easily create and manage custom forms. As an end user, I can anonymously submit my responses to various types of questions such as text, dropdown options, and checkboxes. The forms are created and managed by admins, who can also view detailed analytics on the responses collected.

The application is intuitive, enabling the creation of forms with different question types, and allows for future expansion to include more complex question types like ranking, linear scale, and date pickers. This modular approach ensures that the application can grow to meet diverse user needs in the future.

## Assumptions you have made for this project?
`Admin Access`: Only admins can create and manage forms, while users can only submit responses. 

`Basic Question Types`: The initial version of the app supports basic question types like text, dropdown, and checkboxes. 

`No User Authentication`: The system does not require users to log in to submit responses.

## Did you learn anything new while doing this assignment? Please explain.
`Modular Form Creation`: I learned how to design a flexible and scalable system for building forms that can easily accommodate additional question types in the future. 

`Form Analytics`: I also explored how to gather and display analytics on user responses in a meaningful way. 

`Handling Anonymity`: I had to consider the importance of maintaining user anonymity while still allowing admins to collect and analyze data. 

## How much time did it take for you complete the project?
It took me approximately `12 hours` to complete the project, including time spent on testing.

## If you had more time, what enhancements will you make?
If I had more time, I would focus on the following enhancements:

`User Authentication`: Add user registration and login to allow users to save and track their form responses.

`Advanced Question Types`: Implement more complex question types like ranking, linear scale, and date pickers.

`Improved Analytics`: Develop a more detailed analytics dashboard with charts, graphs, and filters to give admins deeper insights into responses.

`Form Templates`: Provide pre-built form templates to help admins create forms quickly and easily.

`Response Export`: Allow admins to export form responses in formats like CSV or PDF for offline analysis.
